summary: The DestProfilePrfClosures module handles operations related to destination profile closures such as selecting, inserting, updating, and deleting closure records. It involves user session management, data binding, and interface controls.
purpose: To manage closures associated with destination profiles, ensuring data consistency and providing user interface controls for inserting, updating, and deleting closure records.

fields.name: SourceLevel
fields.description: The level of source for the operation, set to 'Destination'

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Handles user authentication and session management

workflows.name: Manage Destination Profile Closures
steps: Initialize user session and check permissions.
Bind data to controls and setup interface elements.
Allow user to insert or update closure records.
Handle data submission and perform validation.
Save changes to database and update session cache.

business_rules: Closure records must be associated with a valid session.
Only authorized users can insert or update records.
All closure operations are tied to a specific source level of 'Destination'.
validations: Ensure SessionID is valid before proceeding with data operations.
Validate presence of required fields before inserting or updating.
conditions: UserSession must be active for any operation to be executed.
If UserSession is null, data operations are canceled.
system_behavior: Display relevant UI controls based on user permissions.
Update session cache after successful operations.
dependencies: HSPnet.Framework for Grid and Dropdown utilities.
exceptions: JavaScript validation errors during event handling.
